sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s by entry; no master’s required. International applicants need≥3.0 GPA on all college-level work;
department acceptance required. UChicago bachelor’s meets degree route. [s1] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
No adviser commitment required. Prepare course form, CV, SOP and separate brief teaching/research
summary; pay and submit for committee access. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No adviser secured before application/admission; generally choose after first two years. Contact
grad@math.lsu.edu. [s1] [s3]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Upload attachments and referees during app; fee and submission required for review. Current letter
receipt/reuse/update controls unverified. [s2] [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing January 15 priority; funding figure explicitly 2024, not 2027. [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
January 15 standing fall priority; later files may be considered, with Graduate School final May 15 according to
math FAQ. Year/time zone not stated. [s3]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
January 15 complete-file priority; later funding only if available. [s3] [s4]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Include all supporting materials by January 15 for aid consideration; separate late-letter cutoff not published.
[s3]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
English if applicable part of complete file by January 15; no separate grace established. [s1] [s3]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
January 15 priority; official final transcripts within 30 days after classes begin for provisional admission. [s3] [s5]

Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Department explicitly says initial PhD offers expire April 15; offers after April 15 specify individual deadline.
Follow 2027 offer; statement about all other U.S. programs is overbroad. [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Published minima: old TOEFL 79, IELTS 6.5, PTE 59, DET 110, Michigan 53. TOEFL/IELTS two-year validity; new
TOEFL-scale threshold not found. International entrants generally take placement exam even if waived. [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed accredited U.S. bachelor’s can exempt only with official completion documents. Current
degree-in-progress waiver not established: resolve before assuming no test. Graduate School may request
score from any applicant. [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; may submit voluntarily in test section and send official ETS scores. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Generic GRE not required; optional submission allowed, no separate math subject recommendation stated. [s2]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Conflict]
Unofficial transcripts from each institution accepted for review; degree audits not accepted. Official final
records within 30 days of classes for provisional entrants. Math older instructions say official before formal
admit; central current policy allows provisional. [s2] [s5]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required fillable math coursework form: course name, textbooks, instructor and grade. Print filled form to PDF
(or print/scan) and upload attachment; avoids browser form-save failures. [s2]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Course form asks name/text/instructor/grade, not full descriptions; separate descriptions upload not
established. [s2]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
CV/resume required; online upload, no public limit/format. [s2] [s5]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required, PDF preferred; no hard length, 1-2 pages adequate. Paraphrase: reasons for graduate math, relevant
education/experiences including REU/study abroad/research, mathematical interests and career plans, and LSU
fit. [s2] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Background and interests may appear in SOP; separate personal essay not listed. [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Optional research directions in SOP; knowing final area/adviser not needed. [s3]
Research proposal; Publications list; Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Optional and can help evaluation: thesis, mathematical writing or other sample of choice. Upload paper rather
than unverified link route; limit unpublished. [s2]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required fillable math coursework form: course name, textbooks, instructor and grade. Print filled form to PDF
(or print/scan) and upload attachment; avoids browser form-save failures. [s2]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Required brief summary of previous teaching and research experience, uploaded separately. No published
length limit. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Historical 2024 math TA academic-year stipend $24, 500 plus tuition waiver; student health cost published
$700/year. 2027-28 rate/fee coverage unverified. Summer assistantships competitive. [s4]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Most PhDstudents supported; guaranteed years not given on checked funding page. [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department admits international students and TA route available subject English; no U.S. citizenship restriction
stated for ordinary TA. Fellowship eligibility award-specific. [s1] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
January 15 admission files evaluated for TA; department applies for fellowships on behalf of eligible candidates.
[s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Graduate School fellowships, adviser/group grant RA and summer TA/RA positions; restrictions vary by grant.
[s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$70 international, $50 domestic/PR; credit/debit payment after submit; nonrefundable each application. [s7]

Fee waiver [Conflict]
Math FAQ says department cannot waive; central excludes international general waivers but suggests asking
program about discount codes. Possibility not confirmed for mathematics; ask before payment. [s3] [s7]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Christin Bibby
Arrangements of complex subvarieties, configuration spaces, matroids, and representation stability; recent
work computes cohomological information for tropical-curve moduli. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Associate Professor; 2027 student availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 online first · A Serre spectral sequence for the moduli space of tropical curves
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Jerome W. Hoffman
Arithmetic algebraic geometry and modular forms; recent collaboration relates Hecke traces to
hypergeometric character sums. [faculty3] [faculty3a]
Professor on current LSU roster; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint · Traces of Hecke Operators via Hypergeometric Character Sums
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Gene S. Kopp
Explicit class field theory, Stark conjectures, analytic formulas for arithmetic objects, and connections to
quantum information. [faculty5] [faculty5a]
Assistant Professor; current PhD advising listed; new openings unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Ray class groups and ray class fields for orders of number fields
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Ling Long
Hypergeometric functions and sums, modular forms, and arithmetic geometry. [faculty7] [faculty7a]
Michael F. and Roberta Nesbit McDonald Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · The Explicit Hypergeometric-Modularity Method, Part III
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Fang-Ting Tu
Hypergeometric-modularity methods and arithmetic geometry; coauthor of the recent explicit-method series.
[faculty9] [faculty9a]

Current LSU faculty; new PhD supervision unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · The Explicit Hypergeometric-Modularity Method, Part II
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Pramod Achar
Geometric and modular representation theory: perverse and coherent sheaves, algebraic groups in positive
characteristic, affine flag varieties, and tilting modules. [faculty11] [faculty11a]
Shirley Blue Barton Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Categorical representations of algebraic groups in positive characteristic
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Ana Bălibanu
Geometric representation theory through Poisson/symplectic geometry, algebraic groups, group-valued
moment maps, and Hessenberg varieties. [faculty13] [faculty13a]
Assistant Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint · An analogue of Whittaker reduction for group-valued moment maps
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Siu-Hung (Richard) Ng
Hopf algebras, tensor and modular categories, quantum groups; recent work on orbifolds and modular
extensions. [faculty15] [faculty15a]
Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Orbifolds and minimal modular extensions
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Published minima: old TOEFL 79, IELTS 6.5, PTE 59, DET 110, Michigan 53. TOEFL/IELTS two-year validity; new
TOEFL-scale threshold not found. International entrants generally take placement exam even if waived. [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed accredited U.S. bachelor’s can exempt only with official completion documents. Current
degree-in-progress waiver not established: resolve before assuming no test. Graduate School may request
score from any applicant. [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; may submit voluntarily in test section and send official ETS scores. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Generic GRE not required; optional submission allowed, no separate math subject recommendation stated. [s2]
